Let’s look ahead with Chapter 10: Looking Forward—Adoption in a Changing World.
As our world shifts, so does the experience of adoption. New laws, fresh technologies, and evolving attitudes are changing what it means to build a family. And for anyone touched by adoption, the road ahead is a mix of uncertainty—and possibility.
Picture a couple who spent years hoping for a child. When infertility left them searching for answers, they turned to open adoption. Suddenly, they were building a family in a way their own parents could hardly imagine—keeping contact with their child’s birth family. Sure, there were awkward moments, and plenty of questions. But this openness brought something powerful: transparency, connection, and a fuller story for their child. There were challenges, but the rewards—those honest relationships, and the gift of truth—made all the difference.
Now, imagine a young adult, curious about their roots, using DNA testing to search for birth relatives. Every new match brought a jumble of emotions—excitement, nerves, even fear. Technology opened doors they never thought possible, but it took real courage to walk through them. For many, these tools are both a blessing and a challenge, changing the way families connect and understand themselves.
Adoption agencies are changing, too. Many offer more support for birth parents, more resources for adoptive families, and more ways for adoptees to explore their heritage. Of course, the process isn’t perfect. But there’s a growing understanding that adoption isn’t just about finding homes for children—it’s about honoring every story, and making space for everyone involved.
The stories in this chapter show us that adoption is alive—it grows and adapts just like the rest of society. Most people don’t realize how much has changed, or how much work is still ahead. But as families, agencies, and communities keep learning and growing together, there’s real hope. The future of adoption? It’s looking more inclusive, more compassionate, and a whole lot more just.
